clock_control.interpretation: Initial offset has a large adverse effect at 0.1 Hz and a smaller favorable success effect at 1 Hz on the same physical seeds; the effect depends on polling rate. This is exploratory evidence of clock sensitivity under the frozen nonpreemptive implementation, not a novelty, safety, or universal scheduler claim.
limitations: 40 paired seed clusters; frozen single PPO bank
Initial phase only; actual submission resets clock after blocking
Physical episode duration includes timeouts and must not be called time-to-goal
Wall-time differences confounded by machine load, especially reused uniform 1 Hz rows
No observed collisions does not establish rare-event safety
No rate tuned on these control results

runtime.scope: Repository and checkpoint hashes are verified separately; runtime checks verify installed version/VCS metadata, not runtime file integrity or remote authenticity.

audit.scope: No official CARLA/Bench2Drive runs; no independent skill retraining; no safety proof.
